title: Unique strict comparison of actual support rows
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring and i:Z→P, j:U→P a complementary closed-open pair of schemes. Work with integer cochain complexes of ordinary A-module sheaves on the small etale site of P [def-pur-etale-kflat-support-data]. Let I be K-injective and termwise injective, and Q any complex whose terms are flat. Let F be a functor on this complex category and η:Id→F a natural transformation such that every F(K) is K-injective and termwise injective and every η(K) is a quasi-isomorphism. Put N=Q⊗I, J=F(N), a=η(N), S=Q⊗(the actual support sequence of I), and T=the actual support sequence of J [lem-pur-etale-injective-support-sequence]. Then j*I and j*J are K-injective, S and T are short exact, and there exists a unique morphism m:S→T whose middle component is a and whose third component has the following characterization: on every total summand Q^p⊗j_*j^*I^q in degree n=p+q, it is the ordinary j*⊣j_* adjunct of the canonical tensor/pullback comparison followed by the counit on j*I^q, the inverse tensor comparison, and the (p,q)-summand of j*a. Equivalently its third component satisfies IsRightMap j Q I J a [def-pur-etale-kflat-support-data]. No B-module action or boundedness assumption is imposed. The map is natural in all chain maps I→I' with any other comparison having the same middle and quotient components. The localized middle component is invertible because eta is a quasi-isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 093X, lemma-restriction-along-monomorphism-surjective; actual support rows and their tensor/kernel comparison, as required by lem-pur-etale-kflat-support-comparison.

proof.text: The support-sequence lemma gives short exactness of both actual support rows and K-injectivity after open pullback. The canonical isomorphism from a short exact row to the kernel sequence of its quotient identifies these rows with the rows used by flatSupportChainDiagram. Its degreewise tensor exactness implies short exactness of S. Its right map has the required summand characterization and commutes with the quotient arrows. Hence S.f followed by a is killed by T.g; the exactness kernel lift constructs m. Extensionality on total summands makes the quotient component unique, and cancellation of the monomorphism T.f makes the first component unique. Naturality follows by equality of the middle and right components and cancellation of the target monomorphism. Localization of eta is invertible because it is a quasi-isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem support_comparison_strict [Finite A]
    (i : Z ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (j : U ⟶ P) [IsOpenImmersion j] (hij : Set.range i.base = (Set.range j.base)ᶜ)
    (I : Complex A P) [I.IsKInjective] [∀ n : ℤ, Injective (I.X n)]
    (Q : Complex A P) (_hQf : ∀ n : ℤ, ObjectProperty.flat (Q.X n))
    (F : Complex A P ⥤ Complex A P) (η : 𝟭 _ ⟶ F)
    [∀ K : Complex A P, (F.obj K).IsKInjective]
    [∀ (K : Complex A P) (n : ℤ), Injective ((F.obj K).X n)]
    [∀ K : Complex A P, QuasiIso (η.app K)] :
    let S := (topSequenceFamily A i j hij Q).obj I
    let N := Q ⊗ I
    let J := F.obj N
    let a := η.app N
    let S' := (bottomSequenceFamily A i j hij Q F).obj I
    let v := OpenSupport.rightMap
      (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j)
      Q I (F.obj (Q ⊗ I)) (η.app (Q ⊗ I))
    ∃ (hI : CochainComplex.IsKInjective ((pullComplex A j).obj I))
      (hJ : CochainComplex.IsKInjective ((pullComplex A j).obj (F.obj (Q ⊗ I))))
      (hTop : S.ShortExact) (hBottom : S'.ShortExact) (m : S ⟶ S'),
      HEq m.τ₂ a ∧ HEq m.τ₃ v ∧
      (∀ m' : S ⟶ S', HEq m'.τ₂ a → HEq m'.τ₃ v → m' = m) ∧
      IsIso ((localize A P).map m.τ₂) ∧
      DiagramNatural (topSequenceFamily A i j hij Q)
        (bottomSequenceFamily A i j hij Q F) (IsComparison A i j hij Q F η) I m
